nodes.name: drop_dispatch_accept_func
nodes.summary: Migration utility script that drops all overloaded variants of the 'dispatch_accept_func' PostgreSQL function by querying pg_proc and dynamically executing DROP FUNCTION for each signature found, used during schema refactoring.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses anonymous DO block with dynamic EXECUTE and pg_proc / pg_namespace catalog lookups to handle all function overloads regardless of argument types.

nodes.name: get_ddl_for_table
nodes.summary: Ad-hoc diagnostic query that reconstructs a CREATE TABLE DDL statement for a given table (hardcoded to 'delivery_option') by querying information_schema.columns, useful for documentation and schema inspection.

nodes.name: result_export.json
nodes.summary: Exported query result capturing a single auth_sessions token hash and expiry timestamp with 'rider' role, serving as a sample fixture or spot-check output from a manual SQL test run.

nodes.name: test_magic_link
nodes.summary: Comprehensive test fixture script for the magic-link authentication flow covering rest_admin, rider, and mixed role scenarios, inserting valid, expired, revoked, and already-activated auth_sessions rows via pgcrypto SHA-256 token hashing to exercise all expected activation outcomes.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses pgcrypto's encode(digest(token, 'sha256'), 'hex') inline — the same hashing strategy used by the production magic-link handler — ensuring fixtures exactly mirror real token storage.

nodes.name: testing_scripts
nodes.summary: Minimal test utility function 'clear_dispatch' that deletes the most recent delivery_dispatch record, used in development to re-trigger dispatch notifications without polluting production data.
